name: catatan_atas_laporan_keuangan
query:
WITH
  base AS (
    SELECT k.code AS akun_kode, k.nama AS akun_nama,
           substring(sk.nosubklasifikasi::text,1,4) AS g4,
           substring(sk.nosubklasifikasi::text,1,6) AS g6,
           kl.noklasifikasi AS klno, kl.namaklasifikasi AS klnama,
           SUM(CASE WHEN kl.noklasifikasi IN (1,5,6,7,9) THEN jv.debit - jv.kredit ELSE jv.kredit - jv.debit END)::numeric(18,2) AS nilai
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    JOIN kiraan   k  ON k.id  = jv.account_id
    JOIN subklas  sk ON sk.id = k.subclassification_id
    JOIN klas     kl ON kl.id = sk.classification_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved' AND k.code <> '3201010100001'
    GROUP BY k.code, k.nama, substring(sk.nosubklasifikasi::text,1,4),
             substring(sk.nosubklasifikasi::text,1,6), kl.noklasifikasi, kl.namaklasifikasi
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN kl.noklasifikasi IN (1,5,6,7,9) THEN jv.debit - jv.kredit ELSE jv.kredit - jv.debit END) <> 0
  ),
g4sub AS (
  SELECT g4, COUNT(*) AS n_sub
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT g4, g6 FROM base) d
  GROUP BY g4
)
SELECT
  b.g4 AS g4_kode,
  COALESCE(s4.namasubklasifikasi, b.g4) AS g4_nama,
  b.g6 AS g6_kode,
  COALESCE(s6.namasubklasifikasi, b.g6) AS g6_nama,
  b.akun_kode, b.akun_nama, b.nilai,
  b.klno::text AS kl_no,
  CASE WHEN b.klno = 3 THEN 'Aset Neto' ELSE b.klnama END AS kl_nama,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY b.klno, b.g4)::text AS note_no,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(gs.n_sub,1) > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS show_sub
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN subklas s4 ON s4.nosubklasifikasi::text = b.g4
LEFT JOIN subklas s6 ON s6.nosubklasifikasi::text = b.g6
LEFT JOIN g4sub   gs ON gs.g4 = b.g4
ORDER BY b.klno, b.g4, b.g6, b.akun_kode {andOrder} {limit}
